sentences.text: Asisten lab menyuntik tikus percobaan dengan cairan pewarna.
sentences.en: The lab assistant injected the test mice with a dye solution.
sentences.ko: 실험 조교가 실험용 쥐에게 염료 용액을 주사했어요.

sentences.text: Dimas meraba nadi di paha dalam anjing itu untuk memastikan jantungnya kuat.
sentences.en: Dimas felt the pulse on the dog's inner thigh to make sure its heart was strong.
sentences.ko: 디마스는 개의 심장이 튼튼한지 확인하려고 허벅지 안쪽 맥을 짚었어요.

sentences.text: Jam pintar itu mengukur nadi Putri selama dia berlari pagi.
sentences.en: The smartwatch measures Putri's pulse while she goes for her morning run.
sentences.ko: 스마트워치가 푸트리가 아침 달리기를 하는 동안 맥박을 재요.

sentences.text: Kucing liar itu harus diberi bius sebelum lukanya dijahit.
sentences.en: The stray cat had to be given anesthesia before its wound was stitched.
sentences.ko: 그 길고양이는 상처를 꿰매기 전에 마취를 해야 했어요.

sentences.text: Putri membaca sejarah penemuan obat bius di perpustakaan kampus.
sentences.en: Putri read about the history of the discovery of anesthetics in the campus library.
sentences.ko: 푸트리는 캠퍼스 도서관에서 마취제 발견의 역사를 읽었어요.
